title: dq-nbomber Config
description: Root configuration file (dq-nbomber.yaml) for dq-nbomber load tests.

NbomberPassthroughConfig.description: Settings passed directly to the NBomber runner.

config.description: Path to a native NBomber JSON config file.

infra.description: Path to a native NBomber infra config file.

sessionId.description: Custom session identifier for this run.

displayConsoleMetrics.description: Show live metrics in the console (default: true).

target.description: Run only the listed scenario names.

ClusterConfig.description: Cluster mode settings for distributed load testing.

natsUrl.description: NATS server URL for cluster coordination.

coordinatorTarget.description: Scenario names run by the coordinator.

ScenarioConfig.description: A single load test scenario (user journey).

dataFeeds.description: Data sources supplying per-virtual-user row data.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps executed per iteration.

loadSimulations.description: Load profile phases executed in sequence.

weight.description: Relative virtual-user weight when multiple scenarios share a simulation.

init.description: Shell command or script run once before the scenario starts.

clean.description: Shell command or script run once after the scenario finishes.

file.description: Path to the data file, relative to the yaml config.

strategy.description: circular: rows loop; random: random row per iteration; unique: each row used once.

partition.description: When true and running in cluster mode, rows are automatically sliced by ScenarioPartition so each agent handles a distinct key range. Safe to leave true for single-node runs — no slicing is applied.

enabled.description: Enable or skip the warm-up phase.

kind.description: inject/rampingInject: open model (arrival rate). keepConstant/rampingKeepConstant: closed model (virtual users). pause: wait phase.

rate.description: Requests per interval. Used by: inject, rampingInject.

copies.description: Number of concurrent virtual users. Used by: keepConstant, rampingKeepConstant.

interval.description: Injection interval in HH:MM:SS. Used by: inject, rampingInject.

during.description: Phase duration in HH:MM:SS format (e.g. '00:01:00'). Required for all kinds.

ThresholdConfig.description: A single threshold expression. At least one of the expression fields must be set.

okRequest.description: Expression on ok-request metrics. Fields: RPS, Percent, Count. E.g. 'Percent > 99'.

failRequest.description: Expression on fail-request metrics. Fields: Percent, Count. E.g. 'Percent < 1'.

okLatency.description: Expression on ok-request latency (ms). Fields: P50, P75, P95, P99, Mean, StdDev. E.g. 'P99 < 500'.

metricExpression.description: Custom metric expression for advanced use cases.

name.description: Unique step name within the scenario — snake_case, lowercase.

capture.description: Extract values from the response for use in later steps.

assert.description: Assertions that mark the step as failed if not satisfied.

url.description: Full URL including scheme. Supports ${BASE_URL} and ${capture.*} interpolation.

headers.description: HTTP request headers. Values support ${...} interpolation.

expectedStatusCodes.description: If set, only these status codes are considered successful. Default: any 2xx.

HttpBodyConfig.description: Exactly one of json, raw, or form must be set.

json.description: JSON body — object or array. All string values support ${...} interpolation.

form.description: URL-encoded form fields. Values support ${...} interpolation.

HttpAuthConfig.description: Shorthand auth helpers (alternatively set headers manually).

bearer.description: Bearer token value or ${capture.<name>}. Sets Authorization: Bearer <value>.

apiKey.description: API key value. Header defaults to X-Api-Key unless apiKeyHeader is set.

apiKeyHeader.description: Header name for the API key.

CaptureConfig.description: Exactly one extractor (jsonPath, header, cookie, regex, or statusCode) must be set.

jsonPath.description: JSONPath expression to extract from the response body. Supports simple paths ($.data.token), array indexes ($.results[0].id), and RFC 9535 filter expressions ($.items[?@.active==true && @.type=='X'].id). Note: use RFC 9535 syntax WITHOUT outer parens — [?@.field==value] not [?(@.field==value)]. The =~ regex operator is not supported; use the regex extractor instead.

regex.description: Regex with a capture group applied to the response body.

statusCode.description: Set true to capture the HTTP status code as an integer.

as.description: Variable name — accessible as ${capture.<as>} in subsequent steps.

default.description: Fallback value if the extractor finds nothing.

AssertionConfig.description: At least one assertion field must be set.

jsonPath.description: JSONPath expression to evaluate (RFC 9535 — no outer parens in filters). Use with equalsValue, contains, notEmpty, or matches.

equalsValue.description: Assert the jsonPath result equals this value.

contains.description: Assert the jsonPath result contains this substring.

notEmpty.description: Set to 'true' to assert the jsonPath result is not null/empty.

matches.description: Assert the jsonPath result matches this regex pattern.
